mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the cleaned plate with the handset was most worthwhile: it turned a delivery problem into a concrete question about who is included in shared infrastructure.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the cartridge before freeing the caster was less engaging because the direct fit failed, though the automatic repair kept it moving.

surprise.text: The handset recognized the address correctly but still refused it, and a directory migration was approaching at dawn.

arbitrary.text: Cleaning the plate with the repair roll was sensible in hindsight, but I initially expected the muddy plate to work directly with the handset.

continue.text: Yes. The contradictory delivery records and impending migration make me curious how the neighbors might challenge the directory, beyond the satisfying physical repair.
